_doc: List prices in USD per million tokens, used for the cost EQUIVALENT only (a Max plan bills nothing per token). Override any model in usage.config.json under "prices".
notes: cache_write_1h is not on the pricing page: 2x input, from the prompt caching docs (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching), non vérifié for the 5.x models
Haiku 5.5 has two tiers: "above" applies when one request's input side (input + cache read + cache writes) is over "tokens"
US-only inference (1.1x) and Opus fast mode (2x) are not applied
